verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Bland serves an llms.txt at docs.bland.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and its docs are published as agent-readable .md pages. The official MCP server also lets AI agents search the Bland docs, and there is a dedicated 'connect your agent' guide written for bots. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt or docs effectively, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.bland.ai/llms.txt # Bland Documentation
run evals, and search the Bland docs, all without leaving your editor.
the bot starts the flow over a plain API call, shows its owner a short code and a link, and polls in the background while the owner finishes signup
